[Gundam Base Color]" from the anime "Mobile Suit Gundam" will be released on May 2nd. It is a limited edition product available only at Gundam Base, a comprehensive Gunpla facility, and will cost 1430 yen. The "Best Mecha Collection 1/144 RX-78-2 Gundam (REVIVAL Ver.)", a revival kit of the original Gunpla "1/144 Gundam" released in 1980, is now available in "Gundam Base" colors. This Gunpla model kit combines a retro feel with technologies cultivated throughout the evolution of Gunpla, such as Iropla, Touch Gate, and Snap Fit, resulting in a Gunpla that is both nostalgic and new.
